description: This file contains repository classes for a sports streaming backend, encapsulating database operations for users, profiles, matches, events, emojis, and highlights.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: Base class providing common database session handling.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user-related database operations.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user profile database operations.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository class for match data handling, including fetching, filtering, and paginating matches.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository class to manage event-related data retrieval.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Repository class for emoji assets, reactions, and summaries.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository class to handle sports highlight data.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record by user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record by email.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record by username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates user information by user ID.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a user profile record.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches profile via user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches profile by profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates profile data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a list of matches with optional filters.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a match by its ID, including related data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Fetches all currently live matches.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches upcoming matches within a specified number of days.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches_by_event_id(self, event_id: str, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None)
methods.description: Fetches matches associated with a specific event.

methods.name: int get_total_matches_count(self, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Returns the total count of matches with optional filters.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_more_matches(self, limit: int = 12, offset: int = 0, exclude_ids: List[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a diverse set of matches for a 'more matches' display.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events with optional filters.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches an event with its related matches.

methods.name: List[EmojiAssetDB] get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of emojis.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific emoji asset.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Adds an emoji reaction for a user and event.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Provides a summary of emoji reactions for an event.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches highlights, optionally filtered by match.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific highlight.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Gets the most recent/popular highlights.

methods.name: __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: unavailable
